summary: Created by esv::swap_places::RequestSystem (bg3.exe+0x2E9E370 = ProcessSwapPlacesRequests, called from the per-frame update bg3.exe+0x2E9DEF0) on a new helper entity, filled with one RequestData (0x30 bytes) per queued swap (queued by LEGACY_RequestSwapPlaces(entity, entity, FixedString, bool, bool), Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7B60). The element type is named on macOS: ls::DynamicArray<esv::swap_places::RequestData>. Creator bg3.exe+0x2E9F560, destructor bg3.exe+0x22CC9C0.

fields.name: Source
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70 ProcessSwapPlacesRequests: element +0 = first handle of the queued request; the assert text calls it the 'source' entity ('...but %s entity doesn't have a TransformComponent', 'source' when the first handle fails, 'target' otherwise).

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70 ProcessSwapPlacesRequests: element +8 = second handle of the request, called the 'target' entity by the same asserts.

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xCFA8A0 esv::EffectManager::ProcessSwapPlacesRequests: element +0x10 is ToChar'ed, split at ':' (SplitStringFast, up to 2 parts) and each part played with PlayAndForgetEffect / CreateEffect at element +0x14 and +0x20. It comes from the SwapPlaces stats functor's first argument (EoCServer.dll+0x162CA70 case 8 passes functor +0x48 to LEGACY_RequestSwapPlaces; Script Extender calls it SwapPlacesFunctor::Animation); game data: SwapPlaces(VFX_Spells_Cast_Sorcerer_WildMagic_Swap_PositionEffect_01:...).

fields.name: SourcePosition
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70: element +0x14..+0x1F = the source entity's Translate (TransformComponent +0x10/+0x18, or the position assigned to it earlier in the frame); EffectManager::ProcessSwapPlacesRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xCFA8A0) plays the effect there.

fields.name: TargetPosition
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x5D7C70: element +0x20..+0x2B = the target entity's position, same source; EffectManager::ProcessSwapPlacesRequests plays the effect there too.

fields.name: _Pad44
fields.evidence: Never written; copy loop (lines 462-472) copies only up to +0x2C; stride 0x30 (alloc size *0x30, line 451).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E9F560: AllocRaw(0x18), *puVar3 = param_2 = the entity the component is added to (also the key of the entity map); in bg3.exe+0x2E9E370 the new entity created by FUN_14401aff0.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +8 (pointer), +0x10 (capacity), +0x14 (size); bg3.exe+0x2E9E370 lines 425-475 assigns the local request array to component+8 (alloc count*0x30, size at +0x14); destructor bg3.exe+0x22CC9C0 clears and frees +8. macOS: ls::DynamicArray<esv::swap_places::RequestData>.
